bias.en: Rebound stalling · under $110, MACD near a cross down
bias.zh: 反弹受阻 · 位于 $110 下方，MACD 接近下穿

read.en: Corning rose 2.2% on Nov 17 to $108.49, trading $104.44–109.46. It is below the 5-day ($113.7), 10-day ($112.5), 30-day ($128.0), 100-day ($151.8) and 200-day ($156.6). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram almost closed (a cross down is close); Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($103.54), and RSI is 38.0.

No level changed: the $109.46 high stalled under the Nov 16 high ($109.88), and the $104.44 low held the Nov 6 low ($104.07). Resistance is $109.5–109.9, then $110.1–112.7 (prior lows, 10-day) and $113.7–114.1 (5-day, Nov 13 close). Support is $106.1–106.2 (Nov 6 and 16 closes), then $103.4–104.4 (SAR, Nov 6 and 17 lows) and $101.8 (Nov 5 low). A close above $109.9 would target $110–112.7; below $103.5, the SAR would flip bearish.
